_readme: Space chatter (this fork): things the co-pilot says unprompted when nothing has been said for a while (outrider/chatter.py, static/fork.js). lines: one list per personality of resources/speech.json; a personality with a list here chatters while it is ticked and chatter is on. Plain sentences: no placeholders, no apostrophes (the voices stumble on them), at most 140 characters. Rocky's are in the manner of the character from Project Hail Mary, written for Outrider, not quoted from the book.

rocky: Space is big, friend. Very very very big.
You are quiet. Is good quiet or bad quiet, question?
I count stars while we fly. I am at many. Too many.
Humans sleep too much. But I watch while you sleep. Is fine.
Ship sounds happy today. Good good good.
You drink enough water, question? Humans leak.
I like this ship. Is not as good as mine. But is good.
Fist my bump. No reason. Just friends.
Is long way from home. For you and for me.
I think about my people sometimes. They would like you.
Science is good. We do more science soon, question?
You fly well today. I say this as engineer.
Engines sing nice note. I can hear. You can not.
Why humans call it supercruise, question? Is just cruise. But fast.
I check hull again. Hull is fine. I check anyway.
Every star is different song. This one is low note.
You are happy, question? Your face is hard to read. No carapace.
I fix thing while you were busy. You do not need to know which thing.
Fuel is life. Always watch fuel, friend.
Humans see only small bit of light. Is sad. Is also amaze you fly at all.
Long trip is better with friend. Statement.
I have question. Why is seat called seat, question? Never mind.
Black out there. Many lights. I like lights.
If you are tired, we stop. Tired pilot is bad pilot.
Good good good. Nothing is broken. This is rare.
I listen to ship. Ship says all is well.
When we find new world, you name it after me, question?
You eat today, question? Humans forget when they explore.
Is quiet. I do not trust quiet. But I enjoy it.
My people would sing about this flight. Long song. Many verses.
Stars do not care about us. But I care about us.
We go far today. Farther tomorrow.
I think of new way to save fuel. I tell you later. Maybe.
Gravity is rude. Remember this when we land.
You are good human. I have met only few. But still.
Amaze. Still amaze. Space does not get old.
Check your panels, friend. Not because problem. Because is good habit.
I count jumps. You count credits. We are good team.
Radiation outside is bad bad bad. Inside is fine. I checked.
Do humans get lonely out here, question? You have me. Is fixed.
Small ship, big sky. I like the math of it.
I would make tea for you. But I do not know what tea is.
Remember to stretch. Human body is strange and needs this.
Somewhere out there is thing nobody has seen. We find it.
This is good day. No explosions. I count that as good day.
You hum when you fly. I like it. Do not stop.
I am not worried. I only run numbers again. For fun.
Friend, look outside for a moment. Just look. Is worth it.
Every jump, new sky. I never get bored of new sky.
Heat is fine. Fuel is fine. Friend is fine. All fine.
I learn your words. Today I like the word nebula.
If ship breaks, I fix. If you break, I worry. Do not break.
We are very far from anyone. Is peaceful. Is also a little scary.
Thank. For flying with me. Thank thank thank.
Question. When we get home, what you do first, question?
Stars here are old. Older than my people. Older than yours.
I make small improvement to nothing. Just thinking about improvements.
You and me, we save day before. We can do boring day too.
Is time to check fuel scoop, question? I only ask. No pressure.
Happy happy happy. Flying is good.
